description: Product photography. Choose: clean studio hero shot, real-world lifestyle, extreme macro detail, or top-down flat lay. Returns the styled prompt stack for your shot and the aspect_ratio to make it at — pair it with generate_image and pass that aspect_ratio along.

aspect_ratio.description: Optional frame shape. Replaces the shape the style uses by default. The answer carries aspect_ratio: pass it to generate_image so the picture is made at that shape.

style.description: clean_studio = seamless backdrop hero. lifestyle = product in use. macro_detail = extreme close-up texture. flat_lay = top-down catalog.

subject.description: What you want to shoot. E.g. "a woman walking through a hotel lobby" or "morning coffee on the balcony".

name: apply_product
title: Apply Product
